item.title: Ofcom fines 4chan £20K and counting for violating UK's Online Safety Act
item.description:
📝 Ofcom's fine is the first made under the Online Safety Act since in-scope organizations' illegal content duties came into force on March 17. Four file-sharing services under investigation for their child safety measures avoided further action by geo-blocking UK users, much to Ofcom's delight. Ofcom said it has closed the cases into these sites, and that the measures have "significantly reduced the likelihood that people in the UK will be exposed to any illegal or harmful content.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theregister.com/2025/10/13/4chan_ofcom_fine/
